# Finite scalar-list grammar
Split flow lists only on commas outside quotes. Preserve commas/escapes inside quoted strings. Existing unquoted lists and multiline scalar lists are accepted. A=[AGENTS.md, docs/a.md]; B and C each contain exactly [docs/a,b.md, docs/c.md]. Nested object items must produce a clear unsupported-format error, with no write.
